findings.title: Purple/indigo gradient
findings.why: The indigo-to-violet gradient is the single loudest unchosen default in AI-built UI.
findings.fix: Use a tonal gradient inside one brand hue, or a flat ground. If the brand really is violet, keep it and note why.

findings.title: Violet primary action
findings.why: Indigo/violet as the primary button colour with no brand reason.
findings.fix: Tie the primary action to the brand colour and give it real hover/active states.

findings.title: Coloured glow shadow
findings.why: Saturated glow shadows are decoration standing in for hierarchy.
findings.fix: Shadow communicates elevation. Use neutral shadows, or none.

findings.title: Tracked all-caps eyebrow label
findings.why: A small spaced uppercase label above every heading is template chrome, not information.
findings.fix: Keep the label only if it carries information. Otherwise delete it.

findings.title: One accented word in the headline
findings.why: Colouring or italicising a single word inside the H1 is the most copied headline move of 2026.
findings.fix: Carry emphasis through the type system: scale, weight, or line breaks.

findings.title: rounded-2xl + shadow on every surface
findings.why: Identical radius and shadow on every element means role is not encoded in form.
findings.fix: Vary radius and elevation by role. A card and a button are not the same object.

findings.title: Glassmorphism by reflex
findings.why: backdrop-blur on a card that is not layered over anything is decoration with no referent.
findings.fix: Blur only where real content passes underneath, such as a sticky nav.

findings.title: Three identical icon-topped feature cards
findings.why: Icon, three-word title, two lines of body, times three, all equally weighted.
findings.fix: Rank them. Alternating rows, one showcase plus a list, or prose.

findings.title: Cookie-cutter section order
findings.why: Hero, logos, features, how-it-works, testimonials, stats, pricing, FAQ, final CTA. Interchangeable with any other page.
findings.fix: Order sections by what this audience needs to decide, and cut the ones that carry nothing.
findings.evidence: 7 stock sections: logo cloud, how it works, testimonials, pricing, faq, features, social p

findings.title: Missing interaction states
findings.why: No :focus-visible anywhere. Keyboard users get nothing, and it signals nobody used the page.
findings.fix: Define :hover, :focus-visible, :active and :disabled, with a transition.

findings.title: Animation without prefers-reduced-motion
findings.why: Motion with no reduced-motion branch is an accessibility failure, not a taste call.
findings.fix: Wrap motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), or honour the query.

findings.title: Generic CTA labels
findings.why: "Get started" / "Learn more" / "Click here" name no action and no destination.
findings.fix: Verb plus object, and keep the verbs consistent across the page.

findings.title: Near-black + acid accent
findings.why: Near-black ground with one lime or vermilion accent is the other post-purple default.
findings.fix: Go dark only if the product earns it, and choose the signal colour for meaning.

findings.title: Emerald as the purple-avoiding accent
findings.why: Tailwind emerald-500 is what a model reaches for once told not to use purple.
findings.fix: Tie the accent to the brand or the subject and give it a job.
